pages.text: The Mystic Branch is the witch's focus for traced workings and stolen creature force. Raise it, hold the channel, and sweep your gaze through old directional signs until the branch knows the shape.

To obtain one, work the night-only infusion rite that turns an $(item)Ent Twig$() and $(item)Mystic Unguent$() into a $(item)Mystic Branch$() on the paired ritual circles. The live port accepts the work for $(bold)3000 altar power$(/) and drops a fresh branch into the circle when the rite succeeds.

pages.title: Current Use
pages.text: Hold use to begin tracing. The HUD marks each up, down, left, and right stroke; release when the named sign appears to cast it, spending infused energy.$(br2)Some signs demand Demon-soul knowledge before they answer. Enhanced signs need Worship power: first strength permits level 2 signs, and stronger Worship permits level 3. Strong signs may also need time to cool.
